title: The 1960 string session and the 1961 date with Wynton Kelly
summary: She enjoyed her first session with strings in 1960, with Ben Webster, and a 1961 date with Wynton Kelly and Teddy Edwards. She says a good piano player means she is in business.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"
